name: Andrea Advincula
headline: Senior Practice Director at Robert Half
about: Experienced Staffing Manager with a demonstrated history of working in the staffing and recruiting industry. Skilled in Coaching, Sales, Retail, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), and Team Building.

experiences.description:
•	Lead and manage a high-performing practice group, consistently driving revenue growth and exceeding performance metrics
•	Provide strategic and day-to-day leadership to direct reports through coaching, motivation, and clear performance expectations
•	Drive business generation initiatives, pricing objectives, and operational execution aligned with organizational goals
•	Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain top talent while building a collaborative, inclusive, and high-trust team culture
•	Monitor productivity standards and performance metrics for both individual contributors and the team
•	Leverage deep knowledge of the practice group to identify market trends and make data-driven business decisions
•	Partner with clients to strengthen relationships, support retention, and expand existing accounts through consultative service
•	Lead change initiatives and facilitate effective communication across internal teams, clients, and candidates
•	Foster a culture of accountability, recognition, and continuous improvement
•	Lead with integrity, fairness, and transparency, promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion across the team

•	Leadership
•	Motivating and directing all branch employees.
•	Incrementally growing branch revenue consistent with Robert Half targets.
•	Providing quality customer service to both clients and candidates.
•	Hiring, coaching, mentoring, and developing recruiting and support staff.
•	Reviewing monthly activities for all direct reports.
•	Actively lead marketing activities as an involved manager.
•	Creating and maintaining a culture of performance and facilitating cross-promotion activities for all divisions.
•	Developing and growing a client base
•	Using proven business development and management background to develop and grow client base by marketing our services for temporary, project and/or full-time staffing solutions.
•	Conducting telephone and in-person meetings with key managers and senior-level executives, for the purpose of prospecting new business and identifying key staffing needs.
•	Using a consultative approach, recommending and providing staffing solutions to clients; meeting with candidates for client meetings as necessary.
•	Solidifying Robert Half’s presence in the local marketplace through consistent participation in networking organizations and events.
•	Working with Regional Management to generate an annual budget and business plan, and provide day-to-day supervision and leadership to his/her direct reports.
•	Supervising the administrative functions of the office.
